title: session.context_fit@1
description: What a hook reply injected past the cap the agent's facts set on injected output (#1296): which parts went inline and which went by handle, the cap, the block's size and the handle the rest is at. Only the core appends it, and only for a reply it cut to fit.

subject.description: The session the reply went to.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

event.description: The hook event the reply answered, such as SessionStart.

cap.description: The cap on injected output, in characters, from the agent's facts.

chars.description: The characters of the whole block before it was cut.

inline.description: The parts that went inline, by name, such as rules or requirement IDs.

inline_ids.description: The handles of what went inline: each rule's, such as rule:typed<id>, and each open ask's requirement, req:<task>#<id>.

by_handle.description: The parts that went by handle, by name.

handle.description: The evidence file the parts by handle are in, read with deep read.
